lines.japanese: 上履きに履きかえて数歩進めば、そこには優美にして広壮なる空間が広がっている。
lines.english: A few steps after changing into my indoor shoes, an elegant and expansive space opened before me.

lines.japanese: 美空学園の一階ロビーは自然光と反射光とに照らされていて、いつでも作り物の春めいた穏やかさを湛えて訪問者を迎える。
lines.english: Natural light and reflected light filled Misora Academy’s first-floor lobby, where a manufactured, springlike calm welcomed visitors in every season.

lines.japanese: これは言うなれば、更衣室とプールのあいだに横たわる消毒糟みたいなものかもしれない。
lines.english: One might call it the disinfectant bath between a swimming pool and its changing room.

lines.japanese: 汝、これより先へ立ちいる意思あらば、清浄なる光もて身を濯ぎたまえ。みたいな。
lines.english: If thou wouldst venture farther, bathe thy body in cleansing light. Something like that.

lines.japanese: 僕は白い空の弱々しい陽射しをガラス越しに浴びながら、気だるさとふたつの鞄を携えてロビーの奥へ向かう。
lines.english: Under the feeble sunlight of the white sky, filtered through glass, I carried my weariness and two schoolbags deeper into the lobby.

lines.japanese: どこかのブライダルサロンからもぎ取ってきたような幅の広い階段が、ゆったりとカーブを描いて二階へ続いている。通称シンデレラ階段。
lines.english: A broad staircase that seemed torn from some bridal salon swept in a stately curve to the second floor. Everyone called it the Cinderella Staircase.

lines.japanese: 始業開始十数分前、スカートの短いお姫様たちが、手や鞄で後ろを隠しながら上ってゆく。
lines.english: A little over ten minutes before classes, princesses in short skirts climbed it with hands and schoolbags held discreetly behind them.

lines.japanese: その中に、僕はまたあの長い髪を見つけた。おとぎ話のような背景の中、談笑に花咲かせながら歩んでゆく学園のプリンセス。
lines.english: Among them I found that long hair again: the princess of the school crossing a storybook scene, chatting merrily as she went.

lines.japanese: 擦れちがう男子の目を魅惑的な磁力で引きつけながら、渡来さんの冗談みたいに出来すぎた綺麗な脚が──
lines.english: Watarai’s absurdly perfect legs drew the eyes of passing boys with their magnetic charm, and—

lines.japanese: 高度と角度と対象の動きとが絶妙かつ偶発的に絡みあって、そのとき、ささやかな幸──不幸が訪れた。
lines.english: Height, angle, and the motion of her body came together in one exquisite accident, and then a modest blessing—no, misfortune—came my way.

lines.japanese: たわむれに友人の腕を掴んだ渡来さんの体が、階段の上でほがらかに跳ねる。真っ白いスカートと、その下のペチコートの裾が、午後の窓辺のカーテンのように優しくひらめいた。
lines.english: Watarai playfully caught her friend by the arm and gave a bright little hop on the stairs. Her pure-white skirt and the hem of the petticoat beneath stirred gently, like curtains at an afternoon window.

lines.japanese: 見上げていた僕の視界に飛びこむ、ペパーミントグリーンの僥倖。
lines.english: Into my upturned gaze flew a providential glimpse of peppermint green.

lines.japanese: まぶしくもない朝の自然光に、思わず目をしばたたいた。
lines.english: Though the morning light was hardly dazzling, I blinked.

lines.japanese: しかしそのわずか刹那の光景は、さながら青春映画の１フレームを収めたスチール写真のように、僕のまぶたに瑞々しく鮮やかに焼きついてしまった。
lines.english: Yet that vision, gone in an instant, had burned itself upon my eyelids in all its fresh, vivid color, like a still preserving a single frame from a coming-of-age film.

lines.japanese: 「おう」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: 後ろで声がしたと思ったら、短い髪を前に立たせた見知らぬ男子が回りこんできて、僕より二段三段高い位置に片足ずつずらして立った。上履きの学年色を見る。居丈高な態度のわりにまだ一年生だった。
lines.english: A voice sounded behind me. An unfamiliar boy with short hair spiked in front circled around and planted his feet two or three steps above mine. I checked the grade color on his indoor shoes. For all his imperious manner, he was only a first-year.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとあんた、どこ見てんすか」
lines.english: “Hey, where d'you think you're looking?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「え、じゃねーでしょう。なァ？　あんた、いま覗いてたよなあ？」
lines.english: “Don’t give me ‘what.’ You were looking up her skirt just now, weren’t you?”

lines.japanese: そう言って一年生が、階段の上へ向けて顎を一振りした。
lines.english: The first-year jerked his chin toward the upper stairs.

lines.japanese: 男ふたりの不穏な対峙は、周りにいた学生たちの足を止めさせる。僕の体は北風──のような視線を感じて、じんわりと冷えこんだ。
lines.english: The ominous confrontation between two boys stopped the students around us in their tracks. Under a north wind of stares, my body slowly chilled.

lines.japanese: 「なんでだよ……違うよそんな……嘘言うなよ……」
lines.english: “What…? No, that isn’t true. Don’t lie about me…”

lines.japanese: 後ろ暗いところなんてない僕はもっと毅然としているべきなのに、どこか彼方から吹きつける木枯らしが砂埃を運んできて、いたずらにまばたきを多くさせた。
lines.english: With nothing to be ashamed of, I should have stood firm. But some wintry gust from far away carried dust into my eyes and made me blink far more than necessary.

lines.japanese: 「ハァ？　どっちが嘘だよ。おもくそキョドってんじゃん、声震わせて何言ってんだ変態」
lines.english: “The hell? You’re the one lying. Look how bad you’re freaking out. What are you mumbling with your voice shaking like that, you creep?”

lines.japanese: 正義感に燃える一年生は、衆目を集めた只中でわざとらしく語調を荒げた。声の通る広い空間に、好奇と侮蔑のひそめきが折りかさなってゆく。
lines.english: Ablaze with righteousness, the first-year deliberately roughened his voice now that he had an audience. In the vast, resonant space, murmurs of curiosity and contempt gathered layer upon layer.

lines.japanese: 「こふっ……こふっ……」
lines.english: “Koff… Koff…”

lines.japanese: 喉がちりちりした。抗弁したかったけど、咳が出て上手く言葉にならなかった。
lines.english: My throat prickled. I wanted to defend myself, but a cough came, and the words would not form.

lines.japanese: 「ま、いんすけどォー。そんな言いわけは俺じゃなくて、本人か生徒指導にしてくださいよ。え、どっちにします？　とりあえず行きましょうや」
lines.english: “Whatever, it’s fine. You can make your excuses to the girl herself or to the disciplinary office. Which’ll it be? Come on, let’s go.”

lines.japanese: そう言って彼は僕の腕を掴んだ。敵意の握力。
lines.english: He caught me by the arm. Hostility tightened his grip.

lines.japanese: 皮膚が焼けただれそうで、思わず払いのけてしまった。
lines.english: It felt as though my skin might burn away, and I struck his hand aside without thinking.
“You bastard…!”

lines.japanese: 逆上した彼がふたたび手を伸ばす。今度は胸倉を狙っていたので、僕はその射線上から身をかわし──
lines.english: Enraged, he reached for me again. This time he aimed for my collar. I slipped out of his line of fire—

lines.japanese: ──すれ違いざまに相手の喉元へ手刀を突きつけた。もちろん丸腰の一般人に当てるわけにはいかない、寸止めだ。
lines.english: —and as we passed, thrust a knife-hand at his throat. Naturally, I could not strike an unarmed civilian. I stopped it just short.

lines.japanese: 「うっ……速えぇ……」
lines.english: “That was… fast…”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと……待ってよ、こふっ……話を聞いて、こふっ、こふっ」
lines.english: “Wait… Just listen to me. Koff… Please, koff, koff…”

lines.japanese: 喉が焼ける。僕は下級生から離れ、大きく身を追って咳きこんだ。
lines.english: My throat was burning. I moved away from the younger boy and doubled over in a fit of coughing.

lines.japanese: 「こっ、この野郎……てめ、なんだそりゃあ！　なめてんのか！」
lines.english: “Y-you bastard… What the hell was that? Are you screwing with me?”

lines.japanese: 若い激昂がシンデレラ階段を這いのぼっていったのか。両側の友人たちに続いて、あの長い髪が振りかえった。目が合って、僕は自分の体が芯まで凍えるのを感じた。
lines.english: Perhaps that young fury crawled up the Cinderella Staircase. Her friends on either side turned first, and then that long hair followed. Our eyes met, and I felt myself freeze to the core.

lines.japanese: ずん、と胃が重くなる。
lines.english: A leaden weight sank into my stomach.

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは表情もなく僕を見下ろし、一回だけまばたきした。僕はまた咳をした。空気が汚い。
lines.english: Watarai looked down at me without expression and blinked once. I coughed again. The air was filthy.

lines.japanese: 友人を先に行かせて、彼女がひとりで手すりを伝って下りてくる。どうしたんだろう、ガラスの靴でも忘れたんだろうか。だったらなんだ。僕は王子様じゃない。
lines.english: She sent her friends on ahead and descended alone, one hand following the banister. What was wrong? Had she forgotten a glass slipper? And what of it? I was no prince.

lines.japanese: 彼女を収められない視界がじわりと滲んだ。大空を羽ばたく猛禽の声に似た笛の吹鳴が、ここではないどこか遠くの国から聴こえてきた、気がした。
lines.english: My vision, unable to contain her, slowly blurred. From some distant country far from here, I thought I heard a whistle shrill as the cry of a bird of prey in flight.

lines.japanese: ガラスの外壁から漏れそそぐ弱い陽射しは、白亜の空間に漂う砂埃を弾いて見事な金色に染めあげてゆく。
lines.english: Weak sunlight poured through the glass outer wall, struck the dust floating through the chalk-white space, and dyed it a magnificent gold.

lines.japanese: きらきら、きらきら……。
lines.english: Glittering, glittering…

lines.japanese: 宙にたゆたう光の粒子。彼方で響く鳶の声。
lines.english: Particles of light adrift in the air. The cry of a kite in the distance.

lines.japanese: 「吾妻君？　どうしたの、おっかない声あげて」
lines.english: “Azuma? What’s with the scary voice?”

lines.japanese: 僕は返事をしようとしたけど、乾いた口の中で舌が絡んでしまい、得意顔の後輩に先を越された。
lines.english: I tried to answer, but my tongue tangled in my dry mouth, and the triumphant underclassman spoke first.

lines.japanese: 「あー先輩……いや、やばいんすよ、こいつ。いま渡来先輩のスカート、下から覗いてたんすよ」
lines.english: “Uh, Watarai... This guy's bad news. He was looking up your skirt just now.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「こふっ、こふっ……！」
lines.english: “Koff, koff…!”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは眉をひそめて僕を見下ろした。僕は咳と闘いながら首をぶんぶん横に振った。
lines.english: Watarai looked down at me with a frown. Fighting my cough, I shook my head frantically.

lines.japanese: 「違うって言ってるよ？」
lines.english: “He says that’s not what happened.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ、そりゃ捕まった痴漢はみんなそう言うでしょ」
lines.english: “Hah. Every groper says that when he gets caught.”

lines.japanese: 「だから……だから違うって……」
lines.english: “I keep telling you… I didn’t…”

lines.japanese: 僕は砂埃を飲みくだして、最上級生の威厳を振りしぼろうとした。だけど、渡来さんが大きく手を振って割りこんできた。
lines.english: I swallowed the dust and tried to summon the dignity of a senior. But Watarai cut in with a broad wave of her hand.

lines.japanese: 「うん、いいのいいの。どっちにしろ、このひとならいいの」
lines.english: “It’s all right, really. Either way, I don’t mind if it’s him.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 一年生が驚いてぽかんと口を開ける。僕もだけど。
lines.english: The first-year’s mouth fell open. So did mine.

lines.japanese: 「い、いいって……なんで……」
lines.english: “You don’t… Why?”

lines.japanese: 「彼氏彼氏」
lines.english: “My boyfriend. He’s my boyfriend.”

lines.japanese: 細い人差し指が二回、宙をつついた。その先には僕がいた。
lines.english: One slim finger stabbed the air twice. I stood at the end of it.
“What…?”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 「ねー、鷹志くん？」
lines.english: “Right, Takashi?”
“Well… yes.”

lines.japanese: 風がやんで、同意を求められていた僕は自信なさげに頷いた。
lines.english: The wind had died. Called upon to agree, I gave an uncertain nod.

lines.japanese: 「一応……こふっ」
lines.english: “Technically… Koff.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは平然と微笑んでいる。反対に一年生男子の表情が硬く引きつっていった。
lines.english: Watarai smiled with perfect composure. The first-year’s expression, on the other hand, stiffened into a grimace.

lines.japanese: 「え……まじすか……」
lines.english: “You’re… serious?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、ごめんねー、お騒がせして」
lines.english: “Ah ha ha. Sorry about all the fuss.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや……つか、あの、こっちこそ……失礼、しました……」
lines.english: “No, I… I mean, I’m the one who… I apologize…”

lines.japanese: 僕らのあいだに立っていた彼は、ぎこちなく渡来さんに頭を下げて、そのまま立ちさろうとした。
lines.english: The boy between us gave Watarai a stiff bow and attempted to leave.

lines.japanese: 「あ、待って待って」
lines.english: “Oh, wait.”

lines.japanese: しかし、彼女はすかさず呼びとめる。
lines.english: She stopped him at once.
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「私じゃなくて。彼に謝って」
lines.english: “Not to me. Apologize to him.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんが視線で僕を示す。声は笑っていたけど、目は笑っていなかった。
lines.english: Watarai indicated me with her eyes. Her voice was smiling. Her eyes were not.
“Oh… right.”

lines.japanese: 「あの……ども、スンマセンした……」
lines.english: “Um… Sorry about that…”

lines.japanese: 「うん……まあ……気にしないで」
lines.english: “It’s… fine. Don’t worry about it.”

lines.japanese: 一年生はばつ悪そうにつぶやくと、首をひねりながら階段を上っていった。ある意味気の毒ではあるその背中を、僕は呆然と見送っていた。
lines.english: The first-year muttered in embarrassment, then climbed the stairs, puzzling over what had happened. In a way, I felt sorry for him. I watched him go in a daze.

lines.japanese: いつの間にか空気が元の穏やかさを取りもどしていたので、僕は深く息を吸いこんでまた吐いた。
lines.english: At some point, the air had recovered its former calm. I drew a deep breath and released it.

lines.japanese: 今日も世界が平和でよかった。
lines.english: Good. The world was at peace again today.

lines.japanese: 「羽田君は相変わらず心が広いんだね」
lines.english: “You’re as big-hearted as ever, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは、敗訴して退場する原告から、冤罪を逃れた僕へと視点を移した。
lines.english: Watarai shifted her attention from the defeated plaintiff making his exit to me, the innocent man spared a wrongful conviction.

lines.japanese: 「どうして怒らないの？」
lines.english: “Why don’t you get angry?”

lines.japanese: 「え……って言われても……」
lines.english: “How am I supposed to answer that…?”

lines.japanese: 困った質問だ。思わず笑ってしまった。
lines.english: It was a difficult question. I laughed without meaning to.

lines.japanese: 「はは……だって、彼も悪気があったわけじゃないし、怒るに怒れないじゃん……」
lines.english: “Ha ha… He didn’t mean any harm, so I can’t exactly get angry with him…”

lines.japanese: 「ええー？　いまのは怒っていいところじゃない？」
lines.english: “Really? I think that was exactly the time to get angry.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、もしおれが逆の立場だったら、同じように注意してたと思うしそれに──」
lines.english: “No. If I’d been in his place, I think I would’ve warned the person too. Besides—”
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: 僕の言葉は、ぽろりと漏れた渡来さんの声によって遮られた。
lines.english: My words were interrupted by the sound that slipped from Watarai.
“What is it…?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、改めて確認するがー、君はー」
lines.english: “Let us establish this once again. You—”

lines.japanese: 気付いたら彼女は両手を腰に置いて、高い位置から僕を見下ろしていた。そしてなぜか、上司か刑事か校長先生みたいな口調だった。
lines.english: Before I knew it, she had planted both hands on her hips and was looking down at me from above. For some reason, she spoke like a supervisor, a detective, or the principal.

lines.japanese: 「君は私のパンツが見たかったのか」
lines.english: “Did you wish to see my panties?”

lines.japanese: 「え……あっ！　いや違うって！　誤解だよ、あれはただの事故だから！」
lines.english: “What…? Oh! No, that isn’t it! You’ve got it wrong. That was an accident!”

lines.japanese: 僕はひとりで動揺していた。一方、上司か刑事か校長先生は堂々としたものだった。
lines.english: I floundered alone. The supervisor, detective, or principal remained perfectly imposing.

lines.japanese: 「では見たくないのか」
lines.english: “Then did you not wish to see them?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「まったくもって見たくないのか。見るのも汚らわしいのか」
lines.english: “Did you have no wish to see them whatsoever? Was the very sight too foul to contemplate?”
